HOW WE WORK

From an idea to a system that works.

This is how we organize your project. Scope, responsibilities and deliverables are defined in the proposal, giving you clarity at every stage.

  1. 01

    We understand

    Your space, your needs and the systems you already have. We listen to your goals and identify opportunities for improvement.

  2. 02

    We plan

    We define the solution and technical scope of the proposal. We agree on schedules, responsibilities and deliverables for clarity at every stage.

  3. 03

    We integrate

    We coordinate the installations, configurations and integration of the systems your project needs.

  4. 04

    We commission

    We check operation, run tests and guide you through handover. Support and next steps are agreed according to your project scope.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Your questions,
answered.

Information to take the next step with your project.

Can several systems be integrated into one project?

CIP offers six specialties in power, connectivity and security. The proposal defines which systems will be integrated and the scope of each.

Do you work on new builds and existing properties?

We can discuss both. For an existing property, we review the systems you already have; for a new build, the construction stage and drawings help define the installation. Feasibility is confirmed during project review.

What do I need to request a quote?

Share the location, property type, service and project stage. If you have drawings, photos, equipment models or an electricity bill for solar energy, mention that they are available.

Do you offer maintenance?

Ask about service availability and scope, including your system, its brand, model and condition.
